issues.description: The solution implementation declares lecture attributes using snake_case identifiers (e.g. lecture_name, number_of_inscribed_students) but the constructor and all methods reference camelCase identifiers (e.g. lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents). This internal naming mismatch will cause compilation errors and is inconsistent with the problem statement's UML which uses camelCase attribute names. This discrepancy will confuse students about the correct attribute identifiers to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make attribute identifiers consistent with the UML and with method/constructor usage. Rename the declared fields in the solution to camelCase: lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors (or alternatively update all usages to match the declared snake_case names). Also ensure mutating methods use the fields correctly (e.g. this.numberOfGuestStudents += numberOfNewGuestStudents).
